First appearance of Michelle Khare and Brian McManus in the Snack Zone. This was a dual snack zone segment with Adam & Michelle on their TER Grand Est train to Basel and Ben & Brian on their airBaltic flight to Zurich. Segment begins with Adam asking Michelle what stop they are at which Michelle answers "S". The segment then cuts to Ben & Brian, with Ben stating to Brian that before we get to Zurich, we have a quick layover in...another well-known Schengen territory. Ben proceeds to ask Brian, "Do you know what it is?" To which Brian responds, "I think I do. It's the snack zone." Segment goes back to Adam saying, "We're in the snack zone, baby." Michelle whispers, "I'm going to the snack zone. I've never been. I'm so excited." The Snack Zone opening sequence and music plays. Both teams introduce their snacks (Ben & Brian: Swiss Schöggeli; Adam & Michelle: Nutella Biscuits). Both teams are shown trying their snack. Ben and Adam both say, "MMM". Adam follows up by asking, "You know what it reminds me of?" Segment goes to Ben asking, "You know what that tastes like exactly?" Adam answers his question, "The sweet taste of victory." Ben answers his question, "It tastes exactly like my favorite food, which is advent calendars."

column16: With Adam and Ben on the Eastern Trunk line of Taiwan Railway train to Taitung. They had surmised that they were going to be sitting on the train for so long that they simply have no choice but to do a Snack Zone Marathon, a big, long Snack Zone. The first snack in the marathon was Garlic Prawn Doritos. Adam: "I'm sort of weirded out that they are such a normal color." Ben: "Yeah, they really look like a Dorito." Adam: "They're really good, actually. I like that way more than I thought I would."

column16: First appearance of Michael Downie in the Snack Zone. On their Western Trunk line Taiwan Railway train to Hsinchu, Michael introduces the Snack Zone which Sam says is illegal. Meanwhile, Adam and Ben on their train to Taitung try another snack for the marathon, dried waxberries. Ben: "Why is it crunchy?" The segment switches back to Michael, who introduces his snack, steamed barbecue pork bun. Sam wonders if it makes more sense for a train-based snack show to be called Choo Choo Chew. Michael is in agreement, but no graphics for Choo Choo Chew is shown. Sam is bewildered Michael switched shows halfway through the segment. Sam also introduces a snack, a sausage and bread with cheese. After Sam and Michael try their snacks, Sam asks Michael, "How many choos outta chew?" Michael: "Two choos outta chew. It's pretty good." Michael ends the segment by saying, "Thanks for watching...Eating Express. Psych, you're on my show!"
